label: Duration
notes: Annual/biennial/perennial; a taxon can have several.

label: Growth Habit
notes: A taxon can have several (e.g. ACSA3 is tree and shrub).

label: Growth Habit (FLOPO)
notes: Redundant coded habit; kept but deliberately not mapped yet.

label: Shade Tolerance
notes: Direction unresolved (spec 2.2.1); labels are overridden to unresolved.

label: Height (feet)
notes: One or two values: mature height and height at base age (20 years), told apart by measurementMethod. Mature height is the larger.

label: Horticulture Flags
notes: Coppice potential and flower, fruit/seed, and fall conspicuousness as Yes/No literals.

label: Adapted Soil Textures
notes: Coarse, medium, and fine soil adaptation as Yes/No literals.

label: Garden Persistent
notes: Values are place names; meaning unclear.

label: Propagation Methods
notes: Propagation by bare root/bulb/container/corm/cuttings/seed/sod/sprigs/tubers as Yes/No literals.
